name: mesa-mark-v-a2-reference
title: Mesa Boogie Mark V clean, with a real A2 capture as the reference
author: monzta1
summary: The FM9's own grounded Mesa Mark V model, built to sit next to a real NAM A2 capture of the same amp: on an A2-capable device the capture IS this tone, here it is the reference the model is checked against.

tone_target.note: Real capture of a Mesa Boogie Mark V, calibrated 18dBu clean channel. On an A2-capable device this capture IS the tone; the steps below are the FM9's grounded approximation of the same real amp.

steps.reason: config/amp_models.json maps FM9's USA MK V Green to MESA/Boogie Mark V, Channel 1 (Clean); the tone_target above cites a real capture of that same amp's clean channel.
Mark V channel 1 is the clean channel; low gain keeps headroom rather than pushing into breakup.
Neutral low end; Mark V clean is not a bass-heavy voice.
Even midrange so the clean channel stays articulate rather than scooped.
Slightly bright, matching the clarity of the cited capture's clean voicing.
Neutral presence; adjust to taste for the room and cab in use.
A usable starting output level; balance against other scenes.

assumes: an amp block (instance 1); no cab, reverb or delay assumed
